31st Richard Moody Holiday Party

Mon, Dec 12, 2022 · 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM · Urban Eatery

When
Mon, Dec 12, 2022 · 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM
Where
Urban Eatery
2730 W Lake St, Minneapolis, MN
More: Holiday Charity Party

Join Richard and all his fashionable friends as we celebrate the 31st year of his charity holiday party.

Please tell your family and friends and share online. This is a free event and supported by our amazing sponsors & the IamMoody Team.
This year our nonprofit partner is The Sanneh Foundation. This award-winning charity empowers kids, improves young lives, and unites communities through advancing diversity, equity, and community well-being.
thesannehfoundation.org

We kindly ask you to bring an unwrapped gift for teens because they are typically forgotten. Donations are also accepted. All gifts and money received will be donated to The Sanneh Foundation

Special Performance by Wenso Ashby
